turns.content:
The issue was caused by a slicing operation in the `templates/flags.py.j2` template which excluded the last item from the `features` list when generating the `ENABLED` set. I removed the `[:-1]` slice from the loop, ensuring all features listed in `config/features.yaml` are correctly included in the `ENABLED` set.

I verified the fix by running the tests, which now pass.
